query:
SELECT a.user_id, a.timezone, a.seen_at FROM suggestion_audience a
               WHERE a.next_run_at <= $1
                 AND NOT EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1 FROM suggestion_generation g
                     WHERE g.user_id = a.user_id AND g.status = 'generating'
                       AND g.started_at >= $2)
               ORDER BY a.next_run_at
               LIMIT $3
